description: Na₅Mn₃F₁₄ crystallizes in the orthorhombic Pna2₁ space group. There are five inequivalent Na sites. In the first Na site, Na is bonded in a 7-coordinate geometry to seven F atoms. There are a spread of Na-F bond distances ranging from 2.34-2.72 Å. In the second Na site, Na is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to six F atoms. There are a spread of Na-F bond distances ranging from 2.28-2.81 Å. In the third Na site, Na is bonded to seven F atoms to form distorted NaF₇ pentagonal bipyramids that share corners with four MnF₆ octahedra,  a cornercorner with one NaF₇ pentagonal bipyramid, edges with two MnF₆ octahedra, and  a faceface with one NaF₇ pentagonal bipyramid. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 31-50°. There are a spread of Na-F bond distances ranging from 2.23-2.49 Å. In the fourth Na site, Na is bonded in a 7-coordinate geometry to seven F atoms. There are a spread of Na-F bond distances ranging from 2.33-2.72 Å. In the fifth Na site, Na is bonded to seven F atoms to form distorted NaF₇ pentagonal bipyramids that share corners with three MnF₆ octahedra,  a cornercorner with one NaF₇ pentagonal bipyramid, edges with two MnF₆ octahedra, and  a faceface with one NaF₇ pentagonal bipyramid. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 27-49°. There are a spread of Na-F bond distances ranging from 2.37-2.66 Å. There are three inequivalent Mn sites. In the first Mn site, Mn is bonded to six F atoms to form MnF₆ octahedra that share corners with two equivalent MnF₆ octahedra, corners with two NaF₇ pentagonal bipyramids, and edges with two NaF₇ pentagonal bipyramids. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 45-47°. There are a spread of Mn-F bond distances ranging from 1.88-2.16 Å. In the second Mn site, Mn is bonded to six F atoms to form MnF₆ octahedra that share corners with two equivalent MnF₆ octahedra, corners with three NaF₇ pentagonal bipyramids, and  an edgeedge with one NaF₇ pentagonal bipyramid. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 35-38°. There are a spread of Mn-F bond distances ranging from 1.88-2.15 Å. In the third Mn site, Mn is bonded to six F atoms to form MnF₆ octahedra that share corners with four MnF₆ octahedra, corners with two NaF₇ pentagonal bipyramids, and  an edgeedge with one NaF₇ pentagonal bipyramid. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 35-47°. There are a spread of Mn-F bond distances ranging from 1.86-2.08 Å. There are fourteen inequivalent F sites. In the first F site, F is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to two Na and two Mn atoms. In the second F site, F is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to two Na and one Mn atom. In the third F site, F is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to two Na and one Mn atom. In the fourth F site, F is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to one Na and two Mn atoms. In the fifth F site, F is bonded to four Na and one Mn atom to form a mixture of distorted corner and edge-sharing FNa₄Mn square pyramids. In the sixth F site, F is bonded to three Na and one Mn atom to form distorted FNa₃Mn tetrahedra that share corners with three equivalent FNa₄Mn square pyramids, corners with three FNa₃Mn trigonal pyramids,  an edgeedge with one FNa₃Mn tetrahedra, and  an edgeedge with one FNa₃Mn trigonal pyramid. In the seventh F site, F is bonded in a distorted rectangular see-saw-like geometry to three Na and one Mn atom. In the eighth F site, F is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to two Na and one Mn atom. In the ninth F site, F is bonded in a distorted trigonal planar geometry to one Na and two Mn atoms. In the tenth F site, F is bonded to three Na and one Mn atom to form distorted FNa₃Mn trigonal pyramids that share corners with two equivalent FNa₃Mn tetrahedra,  an edgeedge with one FNa₄Mn square pyramid,  an edgeedge with one FNa₃Mn tetrahedra, and  an edgeedge with one FNa₃Mn trigonal pyramid. In the eleventh F site, F is bonded to three Na and one Mn atom to form distorted FNa₃Mn trigonal pyramids that share corners with three FNa₃Mn tetrahedra,  an edgeedge with one FNa₄Mn square pyramid,  an edgeedge with one FNa₃Mn tetrahedra, and  an edgeedge with one FNa₃Mn trigonal pyramid. In the twelfth F site, F is bonded to three Na and one Mn atom to form distorted FNa₃Mn tetrahedra that share corners with three equivalent FNa₄Mn square pyramids, corners with two equivalent FNa₃Mn trigonal pyramids,  an edgeedge with one FNa₃Mn tetrahedra, and  an edgeedge with one FNa₃Mn trigonal pyramid. In the thirteenth F site, F is bonded in a distorted rectangular see-saw-like geometry to three Na and one Mn atom. In the fourteenth F site, F is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to two Na and two Mn atoms.
